uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Fighter Mode: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced. The user lunges towards the target Pokémon, dealing increased damage and increasing the user's attack speed by 30% for 8 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times and the duration refreshes when gaining another stack.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.

The user nuzzles their electrified cheeks against the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and leaving them paralyzed. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% for 2s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s.

Unleash an electrified punch in the designated direction, dealing damage, slowing opposing Pokémon hit by 40% and reducing their attack speed by 10% for 2s. Fighter Mode: This move has a shorter range and no longer applies a slowing effect, but instead deals increased damage.
Increases the damage dealt by this move.

The user charges up receiving 30% less damage and becomes unstoppable, then dives toward the designated area after releasing, gaining a shield for 3.5s, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon hit by 30% for 2s. If this move misses, the user takes 3% of their remaining HP as damage instead. When this move hits, the move can be used again; when used a second time, the user unleashes a punch in front of themself, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon hit. Fighter Mode: The first stage of this move no longer applies a slowing effect and the area of effect is decreased, but this move deals increased damage and no longer has a charge time.
Strengthens the slowing effect to 40% for 2s. Fighter Mode: Further increases damage dealt by this move.
The user attacks a designated opposing Pokémon with sharp claws, dealing damage.

The user cloaks themself in electricity and dashes at an opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and moving behind them. For a short time after using this move, this move can be used once more. Fighter Mode: This move cannot be used more than once before going on cooldown, but the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 3s instead.

Dash at blinding speed towards the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, shoving them, and leaving them unable to act for 0.6s. This move's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s every time a basic attack hits. Fighter Mode: This move no longer shoves or leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act, but the number of attacks for this move is increased to 3 hits.
Increases the length of time opposing Pokémon are left unable to act to 1s. Fighter Mode: Increases damage dealt by this move.

Charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and nearby opposing Pokémon. After using this move, the user enters Fighter Mode for 8s and resets the cooldown of all other moves. The Unite Move gauge will only charge when the user's basic attacks and moves hit opposing Pokémon. Basic Attacks against Pokémon from the opposing team increase Unite Move gauge by 4% and moves increase the gauge by 8%. Basic Attacks against wild Pokémon increase Unite Move gauge by 1% and moves increase the gauge by 2%. Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge. Gain 30% omni-vamp while Fighter Mode is active.

source.name: Zip Zap Full-Charge Spark
source.originalDescription: Charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage to the target and nearby opposing Pokémon. After using this move, the user enters Fighter Mode for 8s and resets the cooldown of all other moves. The Unite Move gauge will only charge when the user's basic attacks and moves hit opposing Pokémon. Basic Attacks against Pokémon from the opposing team increase Unite Move gauge by 4% and moves increase the gauge by 8%. Basic Attacks against wild Pokémon increase Unite Move gauge by 1% and moves increase the gauge by 2%. Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge. Gain 30% omni-vamp while Fighter Mode is active.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Zip Zap Full-Charge Spark は スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
